beats.text: Alex Hale's pass is cut out by Jordan Ferraro. VAEP +0.210: the largest of the 7 facts that built the chance, 92% of the 0.228 xG chance (next: -0.028).
beats.fan: Alex Hale's pass is intercepted by Jordan Ferraro, setting up the play.
beats.deep: Hale is positioned 2.8 m deeper than their average in this phase of play, with Ferraro 1.9 m away. Ferraro is 9.3 m higher up the pitch than their average in this phase, with Hale 2.4 m away. Eastport's control in the middle of the box increased from 0.60 to 0.66 over 1.2 seconds, culminating in the goal.
beats.deep_fan: Hale is deeper than usual in this phase, close to Ferraro, who is positioned much higher than usual. Eastport's control of the middle of the box grows, leading to the goal.

beats.text: Where Northbridge go wrong: Sam Brandt loses Ferraro, who moves towards the middle of the box. Sam Brandt ends up 22.0 m from where the shot is taken, having started 3.3 m from it.
beats.fan: Northbridge's defense falters as Sam Brandt loses track of Ferraro, allowing him to move into a dangerous position.
beats.deep: Sam Brandt is positioned 2.7 m higher than their average in this phase, with 9.1 m to the nearest opponent. Eastport's control in the middle of the box increased from 0.15 to 0.37 over 4 seconds, leading to the goal.
